Semiconductor & Edge AI

Make generative vision work on the target device

For SoC, imaging, and embedded product teams, we assess model quality, latency, memory, and power on the device, then scope conversion, runtime integration, and acceptance tests.

Plan your projectContact the team

Business problems

  • A desktop GPU prototype produces good images while the target runtime lacks operators or constrains input shapes.
  • Lower precision and frame-by-frame processing can change color, mask boundaries, or temporal consistency.
  • Thermal limits, peak memory, and data transfer can become bottlenecks before model inference itself.

Engineering capabilities

  • Measure preprocessing, inference, postprocessing, and data transfer separately to establish a reproducible baseline.
  • Check operator and precision support, then compare static shapes, pruning, quantization, or alternative conversion paths where appropriate.
  • Compare accuracy and image quality on controlled samples, then repeat latency, memory, and sustained-load tests on the device.

Frequently asked questions

Can you guarantee a latency on a specific NPU?

We first benchmark the target device using the agreed chip, SDK, input dimensions, and power limits. Those measurements inform the acceptance criteria.

Can you start with an existing PyTorch or ONNX model?

Yes. Share the model provenance, weight license, representative inputs, and the runtimes or conversion tools already tried.

Discuss your project

Share your target environment, representative needs, and acceptance criteria so we can scope the next step.
